localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
G1 is a walk in/tent only group camp. Fire pit, water, benches, picnic tables, and barbecues are provided. Restrooms and parking are nearby. Groups with trailers and RVs will need to reserve separate campsites. Parking for 10 vehicles is included with your group camp rental. Additional vehicles will be charged the extra vehicle fee of $10 per night.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.
Site has 30 and 50 Amp electrical service. All tents must be on tent pad only.
